name: Perezoso AI for WooCommerce
author: Perezoso AI

sections.description:
Perezoso AI is for WooCommerce clothing stores. You upload the flat-lay, hanger or mannequin photos you already take. Perezoso AI turns them into on-model photos, writes the product copy, and creates the WooCommerce products in your own store.

What it does

  • AI model photos. Each garment is shown on a model in the style you pick: evening (polished hair and make-up, an elegant pose) or casual (natural light, a relaxed pose). Add a photo of the back and you also get the model seen from behind, in the same setting.
  • Product copy. Title, description, short description and tags.
  • SEO fields for Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress, whichever one your store uses.
  • Variable products. One variation for every colour and size. The colour of each photo is recognised for you and matched to the colours already in your store.
  • You check everything first. A confirmation table shows what was recognised before anything is generated, and you set prices, sizes and categories there. On the single-product page you review the text and photos before you publish or save a draft.

Two ways to work

  • Single product: one product at a time. You say which colour each photo is and whether it shows the front or the back.
  • Bulk products: choose a folder with one subfolder per product, named after its SKU. Colours and front or back views are recognised automatically. Products are created in the background, so you can close the page after you submit.

What it supports today: womenswear, in two styles: party and evening dresses, and casual everyday clothing. Menswear, children’s clothing, shoes and bags are not supported yet.

Your store stays yours. The plugin creates products with your site’s own permissions. The Perezoso AI service never needs your WordPress password, application passwords or WooCommerce API keys.

Perezoso AI is our own product and service (perezosoai.com). It works with WooCommerce but is not affiliated with or endorsed by WooCommerce or Automattic.

A Perezoso AI account is required. Photo recognition, model photos and copywriting run on the Perezoso AI service, which needs a paid plan. Every plan starts with a free trial. See plans and prices at perezosoai.com/pricing.

External services

This plugin relies on the Perezoso AI service at https://perezosoai.com, run by the plugin’s authors. Without it the plugin cannot recognise photos, generate images or write product copy.

Nothing is sent before you connect. The plugin makes no requests to the service until you click “Connect to Perezoso AI” in its settings and approve the connection on perezosoai.com.

What is sent, and when:

  • When you connect or disconnect: a one-time connection code and your site address (to tie the connection to this site).
  • When you open the plugin’s pages: a request for your account status (plan, photo credits left).
  • When you submit products: the product photos you selected with their file names and SKUs, the colours and sizes defined in your store, the choices you made in the confirmation table (colours, style, prices, categories), your store’s languages and currency, your site address, and the store name if you entered one in the settings.
  • While products are being made: requests for their progress, and downloads of the finished text and images, which the plugin then saves into your store. Once a product is created, the plugin reports the new product ID back to the service.
  • When you click “Manage subscription” or “Subscribe”: a request for a link to the billing page, which opens in your browser.

Who processes the data: the service uses OpenAI to recognise photos, generate the model photos and write the copy. Payments are handled by Stripe on the billing pages, not inside the plugin. Uploaded photos and generated images are deleted from the service once the products have been created in your store.

  • Perezoso AI terms of service: https://perezosoai.com/terms
  • Perezoso AI privacy policy: https://perezosoai.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install Perezoso AI for WooCommerce from Plugins, Add New, and activate it.
  3. Go to Perezoso AI, Settings, and click “Connect to Perezoso AI”.
  4. Sign in to your Perezoso AI account (or create one) and approve the connection.
  5. Open Perezoso AI, Single product, and make your first product.

The settings page also has an environment check. It tells you whether your site can run the background queue that creates products after you close the page.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

Yes. The plugin is the part that runs in your WordPress; the recognition, image generation and copywriting run on the Perezoso AI service. Every plan starts with a free trial.

Does the service get access to my store?

No. It never receives a password or API key for your store. The plugin downloads the finished products and creates them in WooCommerce itself, with your site’s own permissions.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

Yoast SEO, Rank Math and SEOPress. All in One SEO is not supported yet; the environment check tells you if that is what your store uses.

Can I check products before they go live?

Yes. On the single-product page you review and edit everything, then publish or save a draft. For bulk products you choose before submitting whether they go live straight away or wait for review as pending.

What happens to my photos?

They are used only to make your products, and are deleted from the service once the products have been created in your store. See the privacy policy for details.

Does it need a page to stay open while products are made?

No. Products are created in the background by WooCommerce’s Action Scheduler. WordPress runs scheduled tasks when your site has visitors, so on a very quiet site it may take a few minutes longer.
sections.changelog:
0.37.0

Released 2026-11-20.

  • Perezoso AI is now in the official WordPress plugin directory: https://wordpress.org/plugins/perezoso-ai/
  • New logo: our sleepy sloth now sits at the top of every plugin page.
  • Connecting your shop opens the Perezoso AI page in the language of your WordPress admin (English or Spanish).
  • The billing pages from the plugin (subscribe, manage subscription, buy extra photos) open in the language of your WordPress admin too.
  • The plugin now shows Perezoso AI as its author, with a link to perezosoai.com.

0.36.0

Released 2026-11-18.

  • Lazy Listings AI is now called Perezoso AI, and the service lives at perezosoai.com. Only the name and the address change: your account, your connection, your plan and your photo credits stay as they are, nothing needs to be set up again, and the old address keeps working.

0.35.0

Released 2026-11-16.

  • The service now lives at getlazylistings.com, our new address. Nothing changes for you: your shop stays connected, and the old address keeps working.

0.34.0

Released 2026-11-16.

  • ProductEase AI is now called Lazy Listings AI. Only the name changes: your account, your connection, your plan and your photo credits stay as they are, and nothing needs to be set up again.

0.33.2

Released 2026-11-14.

  • WordPress now checks that WooCommerce is installed and active before it lets you activate the plugin (WordPress 6.5 or newer).

0.33.1

Released 2026-11-12.

  • Bulk products: the list of products and photos found in the chosen folder is now translated too.

0.33.0

Released 2026-11-12.

  • The plugin is now available in Spanish. It follows the language set in your WordPress profile, or the site language if you have not set one.
  • Small fixes found by the official WordPress Plugin Check.

0.32.1

Released 2026-11-07.

  • View details on the WordPress Plugins page now lists what changed in each version.

0.32.0

Released 2026-11-03.

  • First public release.
